$comment: RAHU — Dimension-style AI coworker, 100% Google ecosystem, no separate UI. Outputs land as Gmail drafts/labels, Calendar events, Google Tasks, and Google Docs. >>> REVIEW THIS FILE, then copy it to .claude/settings.json to activate. It is shipped as .example so nothing auto-grants permissions or registers hooks without your explicit opt-in. <<<
$comment_model: Default = Sonnet (good writing + reasoning). Per-task overrides live in each agent's frontmatter: Haiku for high-volume triage/extraction, Opus for deal/IC-memo deep reasoning. See README 'Model routing'.

google-workspace.$comment: Open-source unified Google MCP (taylorwilsdon/google_workspace_mcp, PyPI: workspace-mcp). Covers Gmail, Calendar, Tasks, Drive, Docs in ONE server — this is the 'no separate UI / everything in Google' backbone. First run opens a Google OAuth consent screen.

$comment_alt_mcp: Zero-setup alternative: the claude.ai-hosted Gmail / Google Calendar / Google Drive connectors need no OAuth app. They lack Google Tasks, so RAHU falls back to a Google Doc checklist when only the hosted connectors are present. Prefer the self-hosted server above for full Tasks support.
$comment_permissions: SAFETY POSTURE: RAHU drafts, labels, and prepares — it never sends mail or creates calendar invites without a human OK (those two are in 'ask'). This mirrors Dimension's review-and-send default. Flip gmail_send_message into 'allow' only if you knowingly opt into true Inbox-Autopilot auto-send.

hooks.$comment_hooks: Optional. Enable by copying into settings.json. SessionStart injects a compact memory digest so agents start context-aware for ~0 extra tokens. PreToolUse on send is a belt-and-suspenders guard.
